CAMPAIGN_NAME: Impact of submarine copper mine tailing disposal from the 1970s on Repparfjorden, northern Norway
PROTOCOL_COMMENT: Sediment cores up to 21 cm long collected from 17 stations during two cruises (April 2013, June 2015) on R/V Helmer Hanssen. Multi corer (MC) with six plastic liners (up to 80 cm long, 11 cm outer diameter) or box corer (BC) with 50x50x50 cm metal box with plastic liners. Core surfaces undisturbed. Duplicates retrieved where possible (~40 g for HM/grain size, >100 g for foraminifera, ~30 g for chemical analyses). Cores sliced into 1-cm thick samples and frozen immediately after retrieval. All samples freeze-dried prior to analyses.

CAMPAIGN_NAME: Impact of submarine copper mine tailing disposal from the 1970s on Repparfjorden, northern Norway
PROTOCOL_COMMENT: Heavy metal analyses performed on pulverized sediment sub-samples (2 g) of fraction <2 mm. Grain size analyses on 2 g sub-samples with pre-treatment per Dijkstra et al. (2016). TOC measured on bulk sediment sub-samples (2 g). Radioisotope sub-samples up to 30 g, homogenized and packed in plastic sealed containers, stored for several weeks before measurement.

CAMPAIGN_NAME: Impact of submarine copper mine tailing disposal from the 1970s on Repparfjorden, northern Norway
PROTOCOL_COMMENT: Heavy metals extracted by nitric acid digestion (Norwegian Standard 4770) for ICP-AES/ICP-SFMS analyses at Unilab/ALS Norway, and for ICP-OES at DTU. Mercury extracted per Norwegian Standard 4768 using atomic fluorescence spectrometry (AFS).

CAMPAIGN_NAME: Impact of submarine copper mine tailing disposal from the 1970s on Repparfjorden, northern Norway
PROTOCOL_COMMENT: As, Ba, Cd, Co, Cr, Cu, Ni, Pb, Ti, V and Zn concentrations measured by ICP-AES or ICP-SFMS (Unilab Analyse AS / ALS Laboratory Group Norway AS) for 14 cores, and by ICP-OES (Technical University of Denmark, DTU) for 3 cores. Both following Norwegian Standard 4770 (1994). Mercury measured by AFS following Norwegian Standard 4768 (1989).
